moments.author: Tiger Woods
moments.quote: Changed plea to no contest on reckless driving; license suspended 5 years; fined $1,000
moments.why: Golf legend facing serious legal consequences—driving license suspended and plea change instantly dominating sports conversation among males 25–45.
